SELECT SUBSTR(W1.PRFM_DT, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(W1.PRFM_DT, 5, 2) AS PRFM_DT_YM, SUBSTR(W1.PRFM_DT, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(W1.PRFM_DT, 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(W1.PRFM_DT, 7, 2) AS PRFM_DT, W1.ORDER_NO AS ORDER_NO, W1.MATNR AS MATNR, SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 1, 1) AS MATNR_DIV, SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 2, 1) AS MACHINE, SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 3, 3) AS PCODE, SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 6, 3) AS BS_WGT, SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 10, 4) AS WLEN, SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 14, 4) AS VLEN, NVL(SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 18, 1), ' ') AS PKTYPE, M1.MATNR_DIV_NM AS MATNR_DIV_NM, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 5, 1) = '1' THEN '내수' ELSE '수출' END AS EXPORT_GBN, ' ' AS CORE, W1.UNIT AS UNIT_KG, SUM(W1.PRFM_QTY) AS PRFM_QTY_KG, ' ' AS UNIT_EA, ' ' AS PRFM_QTY_EA, ' ' AS UNIT_R, ' ' AS PRFM_QTY_R, ' ' AS SHEET_GBN, ' ' AS PKCNT, M012.MACH_CD AS MACH_CD, M012.MACH_NM AS MACH_NM FROM TB_WRK002 W1 INNER JOIN TB_MAS001 M1 ON W1.WERKS = M1.WERKS AND W1.MATNR = M1.MATNR INNER JOIN TB_SCH015 S017 ON W1.WERKS = S017.WERKS AND W1.WRK_ORDR_NO = S017.WRK_ORDR_NO AND W1.WRK_ORDR_SEQNO = S017.WRK_ORDR_SEQNO INNER JOIN TB_MAS012 M012 ON W1.MACH_CD = M012.MACH_CD WHERE 1=1 AND NVL(W1.PRFM_GTHR_YN, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(W1.CNL_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND W1.WERKS = #{WERKS} AND W1.PRFM_DT BETWEEN #{SDATE} AND #{EDATE} -- 실적일자 AND W1.MATNR LIKE '%' || #{MATNR} || '%' -- 자재코드 AND S017.ORDER_NO LIKE '%' || #{ORDER_NO} || '%' -- 오더번호 AND S017.TO_MACHINE LIKE '%' || #{MACHINE} || '%' -- 생산호기 AND W1.MACH_CD LIKE '%' || #{MACH_CD} || '%' -- 설비코드 GROUP BY W1.PRFM_DT, W1.MATNR, M1.MATNR_DIV_NM, W1.UNIT, S017.SHEET, M012.MACH_NM, W1.ORDER_NO, M012.MACH_CD ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT SUBSTR(W1.PRFM_DT, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(W1.PRFM_DT, 5, 2) AS PRFM_DT_YM, SUBSTR(W1.PRFM_DT, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(W1.PRFM_DT, 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(W1.PRFM_DT, 7, 2) AS PRFM_DT, W1.ORDER_NO AS ORDER_NO, W1.MATNR AS MATNR, SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 1, 1) AS MATNR_DIV, SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 2, 1) AS MACHINE, SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 3, 3) AS PCODE, SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 6, 3) AS BS_WGT, SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 10, 4) AS WLEN, SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 14, 4) AS VLEN, NVL(SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 18, 1), ' ') AS PKTYPE, M1.MATNR_DIV_NM AS MATNR_DIV_NM, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 5, 1) = '1' THEN '내수' ELSE '수출' END AS EXPORT_GBN, W1.CORE AS CORE, W1.UNIT AS UNIT_KG, SUM(W1.PRFM_QTY) AS PRFM_QTY_KG, ' ' AS UNIT_EA, ' ' AS PRFM_QTY_EA, ' ' AS UNIT_R, ' ' AS PRFM_QTY_R, CASE WHEN S017.SHEET = 'X' THEN '시트' ELSE '롤' END AS SHEET_GBN, ' ' AS PKCNT, M012.MACH_CD AS MACH_CD, M012.MACH_NM AS MACH_NM FROM TB_WRK002 W1 INNER JOIN TB_MAS001 M1 ON W1.WERKS = M1.WERKS AND W1.MATNR = M1.MATNR INNER JOIN TB_SCH016 S017 ON W1.WERKS = S017.WERKS AND W1.WRK_ORDR_NO = S017.WRK_ORDR_NO AND W1.WRK_ORDR_SEQNO = S017.WRK_ORDR_SEQNO INNER JOIN TB_MAS012 M012 ON W1.MACH_CD = M012.MACH_CD WHERE 1=1 AND NVL(W1.PRFM_GTHR_YN, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(W1.CNL_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND W1.WERKS = #{WERKS} AND W1.PRFM_DT BETWEEN #{SDATE} AND #{EDATE} -- 실적일자 AND W1.MATNR LIKE '%' || #{MATNR} || '%' -- 자재코드 AND S017.ORDER_NO LIKE '%' || #{ORDER_NO} || '%' -- 오더번호 AND S017.TO_MACHINE LIKE '%' || #{MACHINE} || '%' -- 생산호기 AND W1.MACH_CD LIKE '%' || #{MACH_CD} || '%' -- 설비코드 GROUP BY W1.PRFM_DT, W1.MATNR, M1.MATNR_DIV_NM, W1.UNIT, S017.SHEET, M012.MACH_NM, CORE, W1.ORDER_NO, M012.MACH_CD ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT SUBSTR(W1.PRFM_DT, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(W1.PRFM_DT, 5, 2) AS PRFM_DT_YM, SUBSTR(W1.PRFM_DT, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(W1.PRFM_DT, 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(W1.PRFM_DT, 7, 2) AS PRFM_DT, W1.ORDER_NO AS ORDER_NO, W1.MATNR AS MATNR, SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 1, 1) AS MATNR_DIV, SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 2, 1) AS MACHINE, SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 3, 3) AS PCODE, SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 6, 3) AS BS_WGT, SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 10, 4) AS WLEN, SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 14, 4) AS VLEN, NVL(SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 18, 1), ' ') AS PKTYPE, M1.MATNR_DIV_NM AS MATNR_DIV_NM, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 5, 1) = '1' THEN '내수' ELSE '수출' END AS EXPORT_GBN, ' ' AS CORE, W1.UNIT AS UNIT, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 5, 1) = '1' THEN '내수' ELSE '수출' END AS EXPORT_GBN, ' ' AS CORE, 'KG' AS UNIT_KG, CASE WHEN W1.UNIT = 'EA' THEN SUM(W1.WGT) WHEN W1.UNIT = 'R' THEN 0 WHEN W1.UNIT = 'KG' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END AS PRFM_QTY_KG, W1.UNIT AS UNIT_EA, CASE WHEN W1.UNIT = 'EA' THEN SUM(W1.PRFM_QTY) WHEN W1.UNIT = 'R' THEN 0 WHEN W1.UNIT = 'KG' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END AS PRFM_QTY_EA, 'R' AS UNIT_R, CASE WHEN W1.UNIT = 'EA' THEN SUM(W1.PRFM_QTY) / 500 WHEN W1.UNIT = 'R' THEN 0 WHEN W1.UNIT = 'KG' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END AS PRFM_QTY_R,
'시트' AS SHEET_GBN, CASE WHEN MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(S020.MATNR, 10, 4))) / MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(S017.MATNR, 10, 4))) >= 2 THEN '두폭' ELSE '단폭' END AS PKCNT, M012.MACH_CD AS MACH_CD, M012.MACH_NM AS MACH_NM FROM TB_WRK002 W1 INNER JOIN TB_MAS001 M1 ON W1.WERKS = M1.WERKS AND W1.MATNR = M1.MATNR INNER JOIN TB_SCH017 S017 ON W1.WERKS = S017.WERKS AND W1.WRK_ORDR_NO = S017.WRK_ORDR_NO AND W1.WRK_ORDR_SEQNO = S017.WRK_ORDR_SEQNO INNER JOIN TB_MAS012 M012 ON W1.MACH_CD = M012.MACH_CD INNER JOIN TB_SCH020 S020 ON W1.WRK_ORDR_NO = S020.WRK_ORDR_NO AND W1.WRK_ORDR_SEQNO = S020.WRK_ORDR_SEQNO WHERE 1=1 AND NVL(W1.PRFM_GTHR_YN, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(W1.CNL_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND W1.WERKS = #{WERKS} AND W1.PRFM_DT BETWEEN #{SDATE} AND #{EDATE} -- 실적일자 AND W1.MATNR LIKE '%' || #{MATNR} || '%' -- 자재코드 AND S017.ORDER_NO LIKE '%' || #{ORDER_NO} || '%' -- 오더번호 AND S017.TO_MACHINE LIKE '%' || #{MACHINE} || '%' -- 생산호기 AND W1.MACH_CD LIKE '%' || #{MACH_CD} || '%' -- 설비코드 GROUP BY W1.PRFM_DT, W1.MATNR, M1.MATNR_DIV_NM, W1.UNIT, M012.MACH_NM, W1.ORDER_NO, M012.MACH_CD ORDER BY 1, 2

WLEN, SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 14, 4) AS VLEN, NVL(SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 18, 1), ' ') AS PKTYPE, M1.MATNR_DIV_NM AS MATNR_DIV_NM, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(W1.MATNR, 5, 1) = '1' THEN '내수' ELSE '수출' END AS EXPORT_GBN, ' ' AS CORE, 'KG' AS UNIT_KG, CASE WHEN W1.UNIT = 'EA' THEN 0 WHEN W1.UNIT = 'R' THEN SUM(WGT) WHEN W1.UNIT = 'KG' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END AS PRFM_QTY_KG, 'EA' AS UNIT_EA, CASE WHEN W1.UNIT = 'EA' THEN 0 WHEN W1.UNIT = 'R' THEN 0 WHEN W1.UNIT = 'KG' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END AS PRFM_QTY_EA, W1.UNIT AS UNIT_R, CASE WHEN W1.UNIT = 'EA' THEN 0 WHEN W1.UNIT = 'R' THEN SUM(W1.PRFM_QTY) WHEN W1.UNIT = 'KG' THEN 0 ELSE 0 SELECT WRK002.PRFM_DT , TAPP.PRFM_DT AS PPRFM_DT -- , CASE WHEN MAS009.LAND1 = 'KR' THEN '내수' ELSE '수출' END AS DOMESTIC , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(WRK002.MATNR, 5, 1) = '1' THEN '내수' ELSE '수출' END AS DOMESTIC , WRK002.MACHINE , WRK002.MACH_CD , MAS012.MACH_NM , WRK002.IND_BCD , SCH016.BS_WGT , WRK002.WIDTH , WRK002.PRFM_QTY , WRK002.KUNNR , MAS009.CUST_NM , MAS009.CUST_CD , CASE WHEN TAPP.WRAP_CD = '1' THEN '원지포장1' WHEN TAPP.WRAP_CD = '2' THEN '원지포장2' END AS PMACH_NM , MAS009.LAND1 , MAS099.LAND_NM AS LAND1_NM , WRK002.CORE , CASE WHEN WRK002.CORE IN (12, 6) THEN 'Y' -- 12인치, 6인치는 항상 O, 3인치는 X ELSE 'N' END AS COVER_YN -- 지관마개여부(1자리) , CASE WHEN WRK002.CORE = 12 THEN 'Y' -- 12인치 : O WHEN WRK002.CORE = 6 THEN 'N' -- 6인치 : X WHEN WRK002.CORE = 3 AND (SELECT USARG2 FROM CMCDV WHERE 1 = 1 AND CMCDKY = 'P100_PROD' AND CMCDVL = SCH016.PCODE) = '1' THEN 'Y' -- 3인치 + 금은박 : O ELSE 'N' -- 나머지 3인치 : X END AS CORR_YN -- 골판지여부(1자리) CORRUGATED , CASE WHEN SCH016.CORE_INCH IS NULL THEN 'Y' /* NULL = 지관인치여부 로 판단*/ WHEN SCH016.PACK_YN = 'X' THEN 'Y' WHEN SCH016.PACK_YN IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'N' END AS PACK_YN -- 포장여부 FROM TB_AUTO_PKG_PRFM TAPP INNER JOIN TB_WRK002 WRK002 ON TAPP.IND_BCD = WRK002.IND_BCD INNER JOIN TB_MAS009 MAS009 ON WRK002.KUNNR = MAS009.CUST_CD AND MAS009.CUST_DIV = 'C' INNER JOIN TB_SCH016 SCH016 ON WRK002.WRK_ORDR_NO = SCH016.WRK_ORDR_NO AND WRK002.WRK_ORDR_SEQNO = SCH016.WRK_ORDR_SEQNO INNER JOIN TB_MAS099 MAS099 ON MAS009.LAND1 = MAS099.LAND1 INNER JOIN TB_MAS012 MAS012 ON WRK002.MACH_CD = MAS012.MACH_CD WHERE TAPP.PRFM_DT BETWEEN #{SDATE} AND #{EDATE} ORDER BY WRK002.PRFM_DT, TAPP.PRFM_DT, TAPP.IND_BCD
